---
description: Draft incident status updates for executive, technical and customer audiences
agent: sre-incident-commander
argument-hint: paste bridge notes or chat, and name the audiences
---
Using the `sre-incident-command` skill, sanitize the notes I provide, update the timeline, propose or
confirm severity against the client matrix, and draft status updates for the audiences I name.
Check recent deployments to the affected service's production environment in Azure Pipelines and list
them as hypotheses to rule in or out. Save drafts to `out/incident-<date>.md`.
